text: Saudi Arabia executed at least 356 people in 2025, a new record for the country, many of them for drug-related offences.

source.name: Human Rights Watch: Saudi Arabia: Record Number of Executions in 2025
source.quote: Saudi authorities executed at least 356 people in 2025, setting a new record in the country for the highest number of executions in one year since monitoring began

additionalSources.name: Amnesty International: Death penalty in 2025 - Facts and figures
additionalSources.quote: Executions in Saudi Arabia reached the highest figure on record in any given year, from at least 345 in 2024 to at least 356 in 2025.
